about: The automap's door marks (P118, Jeremy 2026-11-26 08:04-08:38; Combat Chat 67): what each wall picture shows in the 3D view. Keyed 'file:block' (WALLDEF<file>.DAX block), one letter per wall in the block's order: D a door (or a building's entrance), A an archway or opening (a tunnel, stairs, a gap in a hedge, an open window), W a wall or scenery. A side the 3D view has drawn with a D or A picture gets a door or opening mark on the automap; a door-bit side drawn with a W picture is a secret door and stays a wall. Sorted by eye from every picture rendered alone (lab combat67/allwalls.gd), checked against the door bits of the sides that use each picture (combat67/picbits.py).
